description: Roll-call snapshot for the NOMINATE appendix (Elitism in the Aisle, R&R 2026). Produced by scripts/15a_extract_rollcalls_bq.py.

source.provider: IMFD datos congreso (Camara de Diputados / Senado roll calls)

legislative_periods.sql: SELECT id AS period_id, name AS period_name, DATE(start) AS start_date, DATE(`end`) AS end_date FROM `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.legislative_periods` WHERE DATE(start) >= @date_from AND DATE(`end`) <= @date_to ORDER BY period_id

votes.sql: SELECT id AS vote_id, external_id, vote_date, source, session_id, type, result, bill_id, article, in_favor, against, abstention, dispensed, pareo, topic FROM `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.votes` WHERE vote_date BETWEEN @date_from AND @date_to ORDER BY vote_id

vote_selections.sql: SELECT vs.id AS selection_id, vs.vote_id, vs.politician_id, vs.selection FROM `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.vote_selections` vs JOIN `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.votes` v ON v.id = vs.vote_id WHERE v.vote_date BETWEEN @date_from AND @date_to ORDER BY selection_id

politicians.sql: SELECT p.id AS politician_id, p.first_name, p.fathers_surname, p.mothers_surname, p.bcn_id FROM `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.politicians` p WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT vs.politician_id FROM `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.vote_selections` vs JOIN `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.votes` v ON v.id = vs.vote_id WHERE v.vote_date BETWEEN @date_from AND @date_to) ORDER BY politician_id

politician_periods.sql: SELECT pp.id AS term_id, pp.politician_id, pp.position, pp.start_year, pp.end_year, pp.party_id, pp.representation_unit_raw_name AS district FROM `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.politician_periods` pp WHERE pp.end_year >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM @date_from) AND pp.start_year <= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM @date_to) AND pp.politician_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT vs.politician_id FROM `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.vote_selections` vs JOIN `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.votes` v ON v.id = vs.vote_id WHERE v.vote_date BETWEEN @date_from AND @date_to) ORDER BY term_id

political_parties.sql: SELECT id AS party_id, name AS party_name FROM `datos-congreso-461817.datos_congreso.political_parties` ORDER BY party_id
